name: 30 Pack - 30x1g Pre-roll - Block Party
description:
Thirty joints, one box. The 30 Pack Block Party gives you thirty full-gram pre-rolls — 30 grams total — rolled with quality flower and ready to smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no running out. Just grab one and go.

Block Party lives up to the name with a bold, crowd-pleasing profile: sweet fruit and candy notes up front, grounded by an earthy, subtly gassy backbone and a smooth finish. It's an easygoing, flavor-forward smoke built for sharing, hanging out, and keeping the good times rolling.

Why you'll love it:

30 × 1G pre-rolls — 30 grams total, serious value in one box
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Block Party flavor — sweet fruit and candy with an earthy, gassy finish
Built for sharing — plenty to go around, perfect for groups and gatherings
Easygoing effects — mellow, social, and smooth

Big value, dependable quality, and everyday convenience in every box. The 30 Pack Block Party is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
